story.title: South Africa pulls its national AI policy after chatbot invented fake citations throughout the draft
story.summary: South Africa has withdrawn its draft national AI policy after officials discovered it contained fabricated citations generated by the AI chatbot used to assist in drafting the document. The hallucinated references undermined the policy's credibility and forced a public retraction, highlighting the risks of using generative AI in high-stakes government work. The incident has reignited debate about AI governance standards in the Global South, where resource-constrained governments may be particularly tempted to rely on AI tools for policy drafting.
